notes.title: BUG FIXES
notes.notes:
-Fixed a bug where some players did not get the final 2 achievements if they had found all 120 cats and used no hints.

-Fixed a bug where the hints would not reset properly if the player had reset the game with more than 0 hints and exited out of the game, the hint count would not reset on game startup.

Let me know if you find some more strange bugs!

notes.title: Cat Search in Medieval Times RELEASE
notes.notes:
This was my first attempt at working with an artist to create a hidden object game. Overall, I like how the game turned out, but I also realize that there are a few things that can be improved.

If you bought and played the game and would like to give me some feedback, I do have a Discord server that you could join, or you could simply comment under this post. If you decide to join the Discord server, I would like to ask some questions about the game so that I can improve the next one.

Discord: https://discord.gg/eVBcVJJuBz

Thanks!
